regime_context: This is a healthy risk-on US tape: the absolute-trend gate is in force (22 of 49 themes eligible, rotation breadth narrowing but not collapsing), and the backtest verdict confirms the gate is the only validated edge — a drawdown/shake-out control, not a return forecaster. Rank-IC is ~0, so the theme ranks are a focus lens only; my leans below are conditional judgement calls, sized nowhere.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the AI-to-Energy handoff CONFIRMS: I would retire the 'Energy is the confirmed leader' hypothesis if XLE fails to overtake SMH in 30-day total return while both still pass the trend gate — that would keep AI Infrastructure as the leader rather than a handoff.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The prevailing narrative is AI Infrastructure, and its leadership rests on a passing durability bar (0.50) with no crowding flag (crowding_z 0.15, crowded false). The ETF proxy is scorable (SMH), which lets a disciplined, gate-eligible long leaning be graded. This is a trend-continuation lean, not a call that AI Infra will outperform on forward returns — the rank alone carries no alpha.
evidence: eligible true, durability_bar 0.50 meets the absolute-trend gate
crowding_z 0.15, crowded false — no size-down caution triggered
theses.dissent: The headline's breadth is only 0.125 — leadership is narrow, and a mixed Hurst tag with r10 -0.09 suggests the move could be stalling rather than trending; the one-narrative flag is false, so this is not a self-reinforcing regime.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day average while SPY holds above its own before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is the clear challenger in the rotation read, ranked 2 with a stronger durability bar (0.62) than the AI leader. Broader breadth (0.636) suggests the energy move is more participation-backed than AI Infra, and the gate is still green (eligible true). It is a scorable XLE proxy. I lean with the trend while the absolute-trend gate holds.
evidence: durability_bar 0.62, eligible true — passes trend gate
crowding_z 0.93, crowded false — no size-down flag
theses.dissent: Hurst is only mixed and crowding_z 0.93 is approaching the caution zone — energy leadership could be late-cycle money rotating out of tech rather than a durable own-narrative trend.

falsifier.text: XLE underperforms SPY by 5% on a total-return basis before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only top-3 theme with a genuine trend tag (Hurst 'trend') and the highest durability bar of the leaders (0.75), suggesting the staying-power leg is strongest here. Eligibility is true. However, it is crowded (crowding_z 1.61, crowded true) — this is a size-down caution only, never a fade. I lean with the trend but flag the crowding explicitly.
evidence: durability_bar 0.75, Hurst 'trend' — strongest trend-health of leaders
crowding_z 1.61, crowded true — SIZE DOWN, do not fade
theses.dissent: Crowding at z 1.61 marks this as a late, attention-heavy theme — the guardrails themselves warn that attention spikes mark tops, not entries, and no basket-level crowding edge exists.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags SPY by 5% total return while still registering crowded before the 45-day check-by date
